scoring_justification: Headline quantities exist only as final reported numbers in step_06_results.json; no raw simulation output is scored, so a full recompute is infeasible. T0 compare with paper gold is appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for the six scored metrics
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and figures: 105 GPa pristine nano, 120 GPa pristine tension, ~90 GPa GB nano (Fig.3a peak), ~70 GPa GB tension (Fig.3c), nucleation 3.54 nm (text + Fig.4a), failure >4.6 nm (text; taken as 4.6 nm).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper’s own reported results for the specific conditions simulated; the reference solution writes exactly these values.

outputs.description: Aggregated strength estimates and critical deflections that demonstrate the difference between nanoindentation and uniaxial tension for pristine and grain-boundary graphene.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the reported values against hidden reference values (paper-reported results) with tolerances and enforces structural relations (gb_failure_deflection > gb_nucleation_deflection, pristine nano strength < pristine tensile strength).

steps.description: Compare reported values against paper gold with tolerances; enforce structural ordering constraints.
